excluded.arenaActivate: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode (dedicated `arena*` rooms, seasons and leaderboards run by screeps.com); a standalone single world has no Arena matchmaking and no Arena activation codes to redeem.
excluded.arenaFindInitRoom: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode (dedicated `arena*` rooms, seasons and leaderboards run by screeps.com); a standalone single world has no Arena matchmaking and no Arena room to assign.
excluded.arenaOrderOffer: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode (dedicated `arena*` rooms, seasons and leaderboards run by screeps.com); a standalone single world has no Arena matchmaking; the offer exposes a Steam key sold by screeps.com, a hosted payment product.
excluded.arenaOrderPurchase: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode (dedicated `arena*` rooms, seasons and leaderboards run by screeps.com); a standalone single world has no Arena matchmaking; purchasing Arena access is a screeps.com payment flow.
excluded.arenaStatus: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode (dedicated `arena*` rooms, seasons and leaderboards run by screeps.com); a standalone single world has no Arena matchmaking, so there is no Arena participation status.
excluded.arenaStatusUpdate: Arena is a hosted screeps.com game mode (dedicated `arena*` rooms, seasons and leaderboards run by screeps.com); a standalone single world has no Arena matchmaking and no Arena activation or respawn state.
excluded.replaysAdd: Hosted screeps.com replay sharing service for offline Survival simulations; replay storage and share secrets are not part of a standalone world.
excluded.replaysList: Hosted screeps.com replay sharing service; a standalone world stores no uploaded simulation replays.
excluded.replaysHistoryShare: Hosted screeps.com history-share links (`screeps.com/s/<code>`); the official client resolves them only on official servers, and private servers serve history through the `/room-history` addition instead.
excluded.replaysHistoryShareChunk: Official-only branch: the official client requests it only when `options.official` is true and a share code is present; with `options.official` false it reads `/room-history?room=&time=` (platform profile addition).
excluded.seasonsAccessGranted: Seasonal World access is a hosted screeps.com competition gated by Access Keys; a standalone server is its own world with no seasonal access control.
excluded.seasonsAccessGrant: Granting Seasonal World access consumes Access Keys, a hosted screeps.com purchasable resource; no standalone equivalent.
excluded.seasonsCurrentLastPost: The Season Chronicle is editorial content of the hosted screeps.com Seasonal World (enabled by the `season-chronicle` feature); a standalone server has no Chronicle.
excluded.seasonsUserRanks: Final ranks of hosted screeps.com Seasonal World competitions; a standalone server runs no Seasonal World competitions.
excluded.platformServersLike: Likes in the screeps.com-curated community server directory, authenticated by Steam tickets; a standalone server is an entry in that directory, not a provider of it.
excluded.platformServersUnlike: Likes in the screeps.com-curated community server directory, authenticated by Steam tickets; a standalone server is an entry in that directory, not a provider of it.
excluded.storeSteamCart: Steam checkout for screeps.com item-shop packages (payments through the screeps.com Steam publisher account); a standalone server sells nothing.
excluded.storeSteamInventory: Steam inventory integration of the screeps.com Steam app (items minted by screeps.com); no standalone equivalent.
excluded.storeSteamPushDecorations: Transfers screeps.com decorations into the Steam inventory of the screeps.com app; requires the hosted decoration economy and Steam item server.
excluded.storeSteamPullDecorations: Transfers Steam inventory items into the screeps.com decoration inventory; requires the hosted decoration economy and Steam item server.
excluded.storeSteamPushResources: Transfers screeps.com account resources (Access Keys, CPU unlocks, pixels) to Steam items; requires the hosted economy and Steam item server.
excluded.storeSteamPullResources: Transfers Steam items into screeps.com account resources; requires the hosted economy and Steam item server.
excluded.storeSteamCatalog: Steam item-shop catalog of screeps.com packages (payments); a standalone server sells nothing.
excluded.storeXsollaCatalog: Xsolla item-shop catalog of screeps.com packages (payments); a standalone server sells nothing.
excluded.storeXsollaCancelSubscription: Xsolla CPU subscription billing of screeps.com (payments/subscriptions); a standalone server has no paid subscriptions.
excluded.storeXsollaCoupon: Redeems screeps.com Xsolla coupons for paid CPU subscription days or CPU Credits (payments/subscriptions); no standalone equivalent.
excluded.storeXsollaToken: Creates an Xsolla Pay Station payment session for screeps.com purchases (payments); a standalone server sells nothing.
excluded.storeXsollaUser: Reads the screeps.com Xsolla CPU subscription (payments/subscriptions); a standalone server has no paid subscriptions.
excluded.survivalActiveGame: Survival is a hosted screeps.com game mode that spawns per-player `survival_<id>` game rooms with invader waves; a standalone single world does not host Survival games.
excluded.survivalCreate: Survival is a hosted screeps.com game mode that spawns per-player `survival_<id>` game rooms with invader waves; a standalone single world does not host Survival games.
excluded.survivalGame: Survival is a hosted screeps.com game mode that spawns per-player `survival_<id>` game rooms with invader waves; a standalone single world does not host Survival games.
excluded.survivalReplay: Survival is a hosted screeps.com game mode that spawns per-player `survival_<id>` game rooms with invader waves; a standalone single world does not host Survival games, and Survival replays are stored by the hosted replay service.
